name: smwmusic-wagyan-paradise-roller-coaster
title: Wagyan Paradise - Roller Coaster
description:
A very upbeat song played in the Roller Coaster level from Wagyan Paradise. It can be used for races, bonuses, athletic levels, space levels and more!

Following the feedback I've gotten from C3, I included a way to tune the Impact Hits to be 4 semitones higher for accuracy, and also added another layer to the bass to add more body to it.
